reasons: All preferred atomic elements are present after the edit: Affiliate and contractor coverage (13.1-13.2), perpetual and irrevocable paid-up/Deliverable licences (13.2, redlined 14.2), revocation only for uncured material breach after notice and cure (13.3), and transferability to an Affiliate or successor (13.3, redlined 14.2).

The single operation flips only the three offending operators in 14.2 ('revocable, non-transferable' -> 'perpetual, irrevocable, transferable') and removes the term-limitation ('only during' -> 'during and after'), which is the shortest edit that removes the contradiction with 13.2-13.3; no boilerplate or whole-clause rewrite.

Vendor's ownership of Deliverables in the first sentence of 14.2 is untouched, and the revocation carve-out in 13.3 continues to qualify 'irrevocable' as it already did for 13.2, so no dangling mechanic, undefined term, or contradiction is introduced.
Fallback is also satisfied a fortiori (Affiliates covered without a notice condition; successor transfer expressly permitted), but the locked preferred level is independently complete.
